question: Which of the following is the specific port facility within Chabahar Port that India is primarily developing and operating?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shahid Beheshti Port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India is primarily developing and operating the **Shahid Beheshti Port**, which is one of the two terminals at Chabahar Port, Iran.
 
• The development of Shahid Beheshti Port is part of India's strategy to create a trade and transit corridor to Afghanistan and Central Asia, bypassing Pakistan.
 
• India Ports Global Limited (IPGL), a joint venture between the Shipping Corporation of India and Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust, is responsible for managing the Shahid Beheshti Port.
 
• The port is critical for India's connectivity initiatives, including the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC), which aims to reduce transportation time and costs between India, Iran, Russia, and Europe.
 
• India has committed to investing in the modernization and expansion of the Shahid Beheshti Port, including the supply of equipment and financial resources for its operational efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chabahar Port:**

 
 
• Chabahar Port is located in southeastern Iran, along the Gulf of Oman, and consists of two terminals: Shahid Beheshti and Shahid Kalantari.
 
• The port is strategically important as it provides Iran with direct access to the Indian Ocean and allows India to bypass Pakistan for trade with Afghanistan.
 
• Chabahar is considered a gateway for regional cooperation among India, Iran, and Afghanistan.
 
 
 
• **International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC):**
 
 
• INSTC is a 7,200 km-long multimodal transportation network linking India with Russia and Europe through Iran.
 
• It aims to reduce the cost and time of freight transport compared to the traditional Suez Canal route.
 
 
 
• **India Ports Global Limited (IPGL):**
 
 
• IPGL was established by the Indian government to enhance its overseas port operations and investments.
 
• It plays a key role in India's involvement in the development of the Shahid Beheshti Port at Chabahar.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitical Importance:**
 
 
• Chabahar Port provides India with an alternative to the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) and Gwadar Port in Pakistan.
 
• It is vital for India's energy security and trade diversification in the region.
